<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have received a response from Brad. He has checked the times I provided with the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor and has confirmed that the only suitable time for all four partners is Thursday at 14:30.

My next step is to book this meeting in the firm's booking system. The `create_booking` function requires the day and the start time of the meeting. In this case, the day is 'Thu' and the start time is '14:30'.

After I create the booking, I need to inform Brad so he can send the confirmation email to the partners. This will complete the task. I will add a message to the workspace for Brad after I have successfully booked the meeting.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
